hebrewText: וּ/מוֹלַדְתְּ/ךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלַ֥דְתָּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/ךָ֣ יִהְי֑וּ עַ֣ל שֵׁ֧ם אֲחֵי/הֶ֛ם יִקָּרְא֖וּ בְּ/נַחֲלָתָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: nativity (plural birth-place); by implication, lineage, native country; also offspring, family
who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
tokens.kjv: bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
tokens.kjv: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.

tokens.bdb: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.

tokens.bdb: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
tokens.kjv: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).
